summary: Phase 9 B3 Light CMS frontend testing completed successfully. All 16 test scenarios passed including navigation, CRUD operations, field types, validation, and RBAC enforcement.
passed_tests: All 5 tabs present: destinations, packages, articles, testimonials, promos
Default 'destinations' tab shows 4 seeded items (Bali, Dataran Tinggi Dieng, Gunung Bromo, Yogyakarta)
Packages tab displays price format 'mulai Rp...' and Aktif/Nonaktif status pills
Articles and testimonials tabs render correctly
Create flow: Added new package with all fields (name, slug, days, price_from, includes, active switch)
Edit flow: Updated destination name, dialog prefilled correctly
Delete flow: Confirmation dialog (content-confirm-delete) and successful deletion
Promo form: discount_type Select with Persen/Nominal options, valid_until date input (type='date')
JSON field validation: Invalid JSON in hotel_recommendations shows error toast
Driver RBAC: 'Konten Web' group NOT visible in sidebar
Driver RBAC: Direct URL /app/cms shows 'Akses terbatas' panel (content-denied)
